tools.name: cst_delete_parameter
tools.description: Delete a design parameter from the CST project. The parameter must not be referenced by other parameters or geometry. Uses the parameter list (no model-history step) and rebuilds; refused with code results_exist on a solved project unless delete_results=true.

name.description: Name of the parameter to delete.

delete_results.description: Required when the project already has simulation results: they are deleted first (export anything you need). Without it the call is refused with code results_exist, because CST would block on a modal dialog.

tools.name: cst_delete_material
tools.description: Delete a material from the current CST project.

name.description: Name of the material to delete
